title: Generic
summary: A general-purpose agent for its organization. It researches, analyzes, writes, builds and converts files, runs scheduled work, and keeps its own memory.
_gcp_roles_comment: The agent's base set, granted on the project to paraclete-agent@ by the installer for every instance, since every instance gets the generic role. Vertex AI, Firestore, logs and metrics. Two grants are deliberately not here because they are not project roles: the instance bucket (roles/storage.objectAdmin on that bucket only, made where the installer creates the bucket) and secrets (roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on each secret a dashboard admin grants). Drive comes from the VM's access scopes, not IAM. No project-wide admin role.
